hypotheses.statement: The CSV writer library change in release 2.1.0 caused the job to exit successfully without producing output
The job encountered a transient input data issue that caused it to exit early without error
The lack of output monitoring allowed the failure to go undetected for eight days

observed_facts.statement: Release 2.1.0 deployed on 2026-01-14 replaced the CSV writer library
The reconciliation job for 2026-01-15 reported success with exit status 0
No monitoring alerts fired for the reconciliation job on 2026-01-15
The reconciliation output for 2026-01-15 was missing from the shared location
Application logs are retained for only seven days
No monitoring was configured to check for job output production
The scheduler only checks exit status and does not verify output was produced
Input data for the job is also subject to seven-day retention
The missing output was manually regenerated from a downstream copy

summary: The nightly reconciliation job for 2026-01-15 reported success but produced no output, discovered eight days later due to lack of monitoring and log retention policies.

timeline.statement: Release 2.1.0 deployed, replacing the CSV writer library
Reconciliation job for 2026-01-15 ran and reported success with exit status 0
No monitoring alerts fired for the reconciliation job
Finance reported missing reconciliation output for 2026-01-15
Responder confirmed scheduler shows job completed successfully
Application logs for 2026-01-15 are unavailable due to 7-day retention policy
No monitoring was configured for the job's output or duration
Input data for 2026-01-15 is unavailable for replay due to retention
Output was manually regenerated from a downstream copy
